svg.title: Why Nativue AI
svg.desc: Eight before-and-after scenes: architecture, source navigation, role handoffs, parallel ownership, independent review, integration, fresh diagrams and tool choice.

g.text: A clearer view of architecture, collaboration and verified delivery.
Understand the code before changing it
Trace modules and relationships back to source.
From folders to the bigger picture.
Go from the canvas straight to source
Locate the actual file instead of hunting for a highlight.
Connect the picture to the code.
A / B / C, with clear next steps
Keep roles, scope and handoffs in shared records.
Give tasks clear ownership before conflicts grow.
We never agreed on the API
See who owns what, and what can run.
Record what passed, failed, or still needs testing.
The agent says it is fixed
Built and verified are different facts.
Verify the combination before the user handtest.
Deliver a version you can trace.
Let the canvas follow code changes
The local service checks changes and shows freshness.
Open separate chats, or delegate when the host supports it.
Choose the tool. Keep the workflow.
Source evidence is not runtime acceptance. Background analysis needs a runner; native agents depend on the host.
SienGe AI Lab · SienGe的AI实验室
